    • currency

      public ReversalSession.Builder currency(String currency)
      ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. "USD". Required.

    • storeLocation

      public ReversalSession.Builder storeLocation(String storeLocation)
      Store location identifier, sent as SaleTerminalData.TotalsGroupID on every transaction this session creates. Optional.

    • autoDisplay

      public ReversalSession.Builder autoDisplay(boolean autoDisplay)
      Whether refund cart mutations automatically refresh the customer display. Default true.

    • externalDisplayClient

      public ReversalSession.Builder externalDisplayClient(BiltNexoTerminalClient externalDisplayClient)
      A second client for an external customer display device. When set, Display messages are routed to it, while the money and loyalty operations stay on the terminal.

    • displayRenderer

      public ReversalSession.Builder displayRenderer(DisplayRenderer displayRenderer)
      Custom rendering of refund cart snapshots for the customer display. Rarely necessary; defaults to the standard itemised receipt, whose credit lines print negative.

    • poiTransactionId

      public ReversalSession.Builder poiTransactionId(String poiTransactionId)
      Terminal reference of the original card payment (from CheckoutResult.getPoiTransactionId()). Required for refund(); a void reverses this leg with a Nexo ReversalRequest.

    • poiTransactionTimestamp

      public ReversalSession.Builder poiTransactionTimestamp(Instant poiTransactionTimestamp)
      Timestamp of the payment referenced by poiTransactionId.

    • storedValuePoiTransactionId

      public ReversalSession.Builder storedValuePoiTransactionId(String storedValuePoiTransactionId)
      Terminal reference of the original sale's stored value (gift card) leg (from CheckoutResult.getStoredValuePoiTransactionId()). Lets a void reverse the gift card charge of a split tender.

    • storedValuePoiTransactionTimestamp

      public ReversalSession.Builder storedValuePoiTransactionTimestamp(Instant storedValuePoiTransactionTimestamp)
      Timestamp of the leg referenced by storedValuePoiTransactionId.

    • rebatePoiTransactionId

      public ReversalSession.Builder rebatePoiTransactionId(String rebatePoiTransactionId)
      Terminal reference of the original sale's committed rebate redemption (from CheckoutResult.getRebatePoiTransactionId()). Lets a void reverse the rebate movement, per the reverse-rebate contract.

    • rebatePoiTransactionTimestamp

      public ReversalSession.Builder rebatePoiTransactionTimestamp(Instant rebatePoiTransactionTimestamp)
      Timestamp of the rebate referenced by rebatePoiTransactionId.

    • redemptionPoiTransactionId

      public ReversalSession.Builder redemptionPoiTransactionId(String redemptionPoiTransactionId)
      Terminal reference of the original sale's committed point/reward redemption (from CheckoutResult.getRedemptionPoiTransactionId()). Lets a void reverse the redemption movement, per the reverse-redemption contract.

    • redemptionPoiTransactionTimestamp

      public ReversalSession.Builder redemptionPoiTransactionTimestamp(Instant redemptionPoiTransactionTimestamp)
      Timestamp of the redemption referenced by redemptionPoiTransactionId.

    • awardPoiTransactionId

      public ReversalSession.Builder awardPoiTransactionId(String awardPoiTransactionId)
      Terminal reference of the original sale's loyalty award (from CheckoutResult.getAwardPoiTransactionId()). Lets voids and refunds reverse the award by its own reference, per the reverse-award contract; without it no award reversal is sent.

    • awardPoiTransactionTimestamp

      public ReversalSession.Builder awardPoiTransactionTimestamp(Instant awardPoiTransactionTimestamp)
      Timestamp of the award referenced by awardPoiTransactionId.

    • memberId

      public ReversalSession.Builder memberId(String memberId)
      The member's loyalty account ID from the original sale (from IdentifyResult.getMemberId() or POS records). Populates LoyaltyData on the loyalty reversals; per the reversal contracts it may be omitted — the original transaction reference suffices.

    • callbackExecutor

      public ReversalSession.Builder callbackExecutor(Executor callbackExecutor)
      Where asynchronously executed operations deliver their handlers — see CheckoutSession.Builder#callbackExecutor. Applies to execute(); executeSync() and the blocking accessors are unaffected.

    • start

      public SessionResult<ReversalSession> start()
      Validates the configuration and returns a lazy operation that announces the session to the terminal (Nexo Admin session start signal) and yields it once the terminal acknowledged. Nothing is sent until execute(), get(), or getOrNull() is invoked.

      If the registered onSuccess handler itself throws, the just-started session is ended on the terminal (best-effort) before the exception propagates.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a required field or every transaction reference is missing
